## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature

## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed (required — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md))
- [ ] A primary label is applied (`bug`, `enhancement`, `documentation`,
      `maintenance`, `security`, `ci`, or `breaking-change`)
- [ ] Tests were added or updated for the behavior changed, and run locally
      (CI does not currently run the test suites)
- [ ] `npm ci` / lockfile checks pass if dependencies changed
- [ ] Docs updated if user-facing behavior changed
